boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UNF study environments spanning reservable rooms, individual seating, technology work, and resident-only spaces.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Reserve a group room through the library before meeting classmates, then use the dedicated room to keep conversation separate from open seating.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for collaborative coursework in the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF identifies group study rooms at Thomas G. Carpenter Library and provides a group-room reservation route.
cards.access_notes: Reservation route is provided by UNF; confirm availability and room rules before arrival.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Graduate Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Use this library room category for graduate-level work; check the library’s current room procedures before planning a long individual session.
cards.short_summary: A documented graduate-study room category within Carpenter Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF states that Carpenter Library has 23 graduate study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Graduate-study room access details are not stated on the cited page; verify current library procedures.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Balcony Seating
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Set up in the library’s balcony seating when you need an individual work surface, and check posted library hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: Individual balcony seating in UNF’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF lists balcony seating among Carpenter Library’s study-related facilities.
cards.access_notes: The library is generally open seven days a week except holidays and semester breaks; check current posted hours.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Computer Workstations
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Choose a public workstation when your assignment needs campus desktop access, and save your work to personal storage before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Library workstation seating for computer-based coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF reports that Carpenter Library has 151 public workstations.
cards.access_notes: Availability and sign-in requirements are not stated on the cited page; verify current library workstation rules.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Quiet Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Reserve a quiet study space ahead for focused reading, drafting, or an online assessment, then follow the library’s current room guidance.
cards.short_summary: Advance-reservable quiet space for focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF’s Writing Program states that the library has quiet study spaces that can be reserved ahead of time.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is indicated; verify the current booking process and eligibility with the library.

cards.title: Virtual Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Thomas G. Carpenter Library, Building 12
cards.notes: Use the Virtual Learning Center when a project benefits from VR exploration; consult the center’s current equipment and session guidance first.
cards.short_summary: Library-based VR environment for technology-enhanced learning.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF identifies a Virtual Learning Center in Carpenter Library where students can explore virtual reality technology.
cards.access_notes: Equipment availability and any booking requirements are not stated on the cited page; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Recording Studio
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Thomas G. Carpenter Library
cards.notes: Book or confirm access before recording a presentation, podcast, or speech, and arrive with your project files ready to transfer.
cards.short_summary: A library studio for audio-visual academic projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF documents that Carpenter Library’s Recording Studio can be used to create podcasts and record speeches.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s third floor; confirm current studio availability and use procedures before visiting.

cards.title: SMART Center Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: University of North Florida campus
cards.notes: Bring current math or statistics work to the SMART Center study lounge, and use its appointment or drop-in options when tutoring would help.
cards.short_summary: Study-lounge setting connected to math and statistics support.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF states that the SMART Center offers math and statistics students a study lounge and tutoring, available by appointment or drop-in.
cards.access_notes: UNF describes appointment and drop-in availability; verify the current location and hours before going.

cards.entity_name: Military and Veterans Resource Center Lounge and Group Study Room
cards.title: MVRC Lounge and Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Founders Hall, Building 2, Room 1100
cards.notes: If you are a military-connected student, use the MVRC’s lounge and group study room alongside its computer workstations and free printing.
cards.short_summary: Military-connected student space with a study room and workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF lists a lounge and group study room, computer workstations, and free printing among MVRC resources for military-connected students.
cards.access_notes: MVRC serves veterans, active duty, Guard, Reserve, and dependents; current term hours are posted on its page.

cards.title: The Morgue at Osprey Fountains
cards.subtitle: North Residential Tower, Osprey Fountains
cards.notes: If you live in Osprey Fountains, use this themed resident space for a 24-hour study session and bring materials for independent work.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour, resident-focused study space in Osprey Fountains.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF describes The Morgue as a library for serious studying that is available 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Located within Osprey Fountains; resident access applies. UNF states it is available 24 hours a day.
